svg.title: How content flows
svg.desc: Five steps. 1, schema types in the repository define the embedded Sanity Studio. 2, editors compose a page from those sections in the Studio. 3, publishing saves the page to the Sanity dataset. 4, a GROQ query reads the published page through the Sanity CDN, cached for 60 seconds; a bundled seed page fills in when no project ID is set or the slug is missing from the dataset. 5, React Server Components render one component per section, as an HTML page and its Markdown version.
